lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Boaz arrived from Bethlehem and greeted the harvesters. His eyes fell upon the woman gleaning among the sheaves.

lines.speaker: field_overseer
lines.text: She is the Moabite who came back with Naomi. She asked to glean and has been working steadily since morning.

lines.speaker: boaz
lines.text: Listen, my daughter. Don't go glean in another field. Stay here with my servant girls. Watch the field where the men are harvesting, and follow along after the girls. I have told the men not to touch you. And whenever you are thirsty, go and drink from the water jars.

choices.label: Receive water for the workers
choices.note: Ruth helps provide refreshment to those in the field.

choices.label: Listen to Boaz's protection
choices.note: Boaz ensures Ruth's safety among the harvesters.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.text: Why have I found favor in your eyes that you notice me—a foreigner?

lines.speaker: boaz
lines.text: I have been told all about what you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband. May the LORD repay you for what you have done.
